newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-TOMMY MORRISON TO RETURN TO RING.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-TOMMY MORRISON TO RETURN TO RING.

text.p: HIV-infected former heavyweight contender Tommy Morrison said on Thursday he will return to the ring eight months after retiring.
Morrison said he will fight on the undercard of the George Foreman/Crawford Grimsley title fight in Tokyo on Nov. 2.
Morrison, who retired from boxing in February after testing positive for the virus that causes AIDS, signed a contract to fight an undetermined opponent.
The bout appears to be a tuneup for a pay-per-view rematch between Foreman and Morrison early next year. Morrison handed Foreman one of his four career losses in 1993.
Morrison (45-3-1) has stated that proceeds from the fight will benefit children with HIV and AIDS.
Since he is unlikely to obtain a license to fight in the United States, Morrison will probably have to fight overseas if he wants to continue his career.
